exact_leaf_retaining_theorem.H: G[W union I], I all selected isolates
exact_leaf_retaining_theorem.argument: Retained leaves exclude every centre. W union I must be independent because every chosen witness already has its own retained leaf. Conversely any independent set of H together with all leaves and unaffected selected edges is dissociation. Matching and equal-size vertex cover certify the exact optimum.

mathematical_issues: No failed bound found. Matching criterion failure and restricted optimum below |S| are not actual beta failures.
Witnesses are distinct across leaves; a leaf can have multiple admissible witnesses.
Touched isolates are counted once per colour, not once per incident witness.
Without isolates nu(H)<=floor(e/2) and e>=2c imply the sufficient matching criterion.
Connected block certificates prove beta=8r and leaf-retaining optimum=7r on each checked r. No exact star-forming-number claim is made.
scope: All labelled fixed bipartitions of total order <=6, plus (3,4); all eligible minimal selections and all direct witness choices.
